task.description: Validate TEST-DESIGNER's new regression test for ISS-0047 in test/letflow/identity_test.exs (a new describe/test block after the existing REQ-018 race test) and test/specs/ISS-0047.md. Independently confirm the fail-then-pass claim (don't trust the handoff summary alone) by re-running the same before/after procedure: extract pre-fix lib/letflow/identity.ex from commit 3d19e8c, swap it in, run the new test, confirm it fails with the username-race error; restore post-fix identity.ex, confirm it passes. Also confirm the test uses genuinely independent :auto-mode connections (not :manual + Sandbox.allow/3) and loops enough attempts (10) to be a reliable, non-flaky proof.
acceptance_criteria: Fail-then-pass claim independently re-verified with actual command output, not trusted from the prior handoff.
Test genuinely uses two independent Postgres connections under :auto mode -- confirm no Sandbox.allow/3 call in the new test.

Test is not flaky -- assess whether 10 loop iterations is adequate given the observed 4/6 nondeterministic reproduction rate, and that the test doesn't silently pass on a lucky run (i.e. per-iteration assertions, not just an aggregate).
No existing test's coverage was weakened or removed.

result.summary: Independently re-verified the fail-then-pass claim: swapped lib/letflow/identity.ex for git show 3d19e8c's pre-fix content, recompiled, ran `mix test test/letflow/identity_test.exs:357` -- got '31 tests, 1 failure, 30 excluded' with the exact ISS-0047 failure mode (result1 = {:ok, ...}, result2 = {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{errors: [username: {"has already been taken", [constraint: :unique, constraint_name: "users_username_index"]}]}}). Restored lib/letflow/identity.ex from the postfix backup (verified `git diff --stat lib/letflow/identity.ex` was empty, i.e. byte-identical to HEAD), recompiled, ran `mix test test/letflow/identity_test.exs` full file -- got '31 tests, 0 failures'. Confirmed no Sandbox.allow/3 call inside the new ISS-0047 describe block (grep only finds it in an explanatory comment contrasting with the existing :manual-mode race test). Confirmed 10-iteration loop is adequate: each of the 10 attempts uses a freshly generated identity_context() (no cross-attempt masking), and all 5 assertions (both {:ok,...}, matching ids, exactly-one-created, exactly-one-row) are inside the loop body per attempt, not aggregated after -- so a single bad attempt fails the whole test regardless of the other 9, addressing the 4/6 nondeterministic reproduction rate ISSUE-FIXER observed (P(missing the bug across 10 independent ~2/3-reproduction attempts) is very low). Diffed test/letflow/identity_test.exs against origin/main: the only changes are the new ISS-0047 describe/test block (additive) and two describe/test name string tweaks (REQ-063 collision tests) with unchanged bodies/assertions -- no coverage removed or weakened. test/specs/ISS-0047.md accurately documents the test's mechanism and its own fail-then-pass runs, which now match my independent reproduction.
